entries.reason: the Tier 2 verdict on Metal/MetalKit: MTKView is a UIView backed by a real CAMetalLayer, which this port already carries (CAMetalLayer8.m); the port's Metal runs over OpenGL ES 2.0, but the view around it needs no GPU driver of its own to lay out, hold state or drive a draw loop
entries.effect: the layer is a real CAMetalLayer, sized and driven the way the header describes: device, colorPixelFormat, drawableSize, clearColor/clearDepth/clearStencil, currentDrawable, currentRenderPassDescriptor and depthStencilTexture are all real and backed by this port's existing Metal-over-ES2 objects; a CADisplayLink drives -draw at preferredFramesPerSecond unless paused or enableSetNeedsDisplay is on, calling the delegate's drawInMTKView: or, absent a delegate, a subclass's own -drawRect: override
entries.source: the header of iOS 16.4 for the contract; this port's own CAMetalLayer8.m, CharonMetalDevice.m and MTLRenderPassDescriptor8.m

entries.reason: MTKView calls it; the protocol status is not pushed onto the class that calls it
entries.effect: drawInMTKView: is called from the draw loop MTKView itself drives; mtkView:drawableSizeWillChange: is never called, since this port always keeps the drawable sized to the view's own bounds when autoResizeDrawable is on and never resizes it otherwise
entries.source: the header of iOS 16.4 for the contract

entries.reason: the Tier 2 verdict on Metal/MetalKit: loading a texture from image bytes needs no GPU driver beyond what this port's own Metal-over-ES2 device already does for -newTextureWithDescriptor:/-replaceRegion:mipmapLevel:withBytes:bytesPerRow:, both real
entries.effect: newTextureWithCGImage:/newTextureWithData:/newTextureWithContentsOfURL:/newTextureWithName:scaleFactor:bundle: (and their array/completion-handler forms) decode a real CGImage into RGBA8 pixels through a CGBitmapContext and upload it to a real MTLTexture; MTKTextureLoaderOptionSRGB is honored, choosing MTLPixelFormatRGBA8Unorm_sRGB; the mipmap, cube-layout, origin, storage-mode, CPU-cache-mode and usage options are read by nothing - a real, stated gap, not a silent one. newTextureWithMDLTexture:... is not implemented at all: it needs a real MDLTexture with decoded pixel data from ModelIO's own material/asset pipeline, which this port does not carry
entries.source: the header of iOS 16.4 for the contract; this port's own CharonMetalDevice.m and CharonMetalTexture.m

entries.reason: the class is real and LOAD-FAIL-safe; its own construction is genuinely walled, precisely at MDLMesh, not at MTKMesh itself
entries.effect: initWithMesh:device:error: and +newMeshesFromAsset:device:sourceMeshes:error: both refuse with an NSError in MTKModelErrorDomain naming the reason: this port does not carry MDLMesh (a real geometry/submesh object model, distinct from the MDLVertexDescriptor this same pass does carry) or MDLAsset (a real file-format importer). vertexBuffers, submeshes and vertexDescriptor answer empty/default rather than crash, since no instance is ever produced by a successful initializer
